task: Stop the supervisor/sub-assistant LangGraph subgraph from looping past agent_token_limit truncation (or client disconnect) by moving the stop into pre_model_hook on the supervisor and sub-agent nodes, plus a consumer-set abort flag.

key_reasoning.reason: Base L (new pre_model_hook in supervisor/pre_model_hooks.py, wiring into both _build_supervisor_agent and _build_single_agent, plus reconciling the two duplicated truncation-indicator implementations across langgraph_agent.py and langgraph_event_adapter.py) bumped to XL: the fix must apply uniformly to the supervisor node AND every sub-agent node, i.e. it changes behavior for multiple agents/workflows at once, not one self-contained component.

Intent is well-specified (pre_model_hook + abort flag, no further LLM calls after truncation), and the technical-analysis document already resolved the exact extension points and files. But several genuine design decisions remain open per its Risk Indicators: how a pre_model_hook — which only sees the *next* call's input — detects that the *previous* appended AIMessage was truncated; whether an exception raised inside _compose_pre_model_hooks' per-hook merge loop propagates correctly (unverified); which of the two duplicated truncation-indicator implementations to keep; and the exact mechanism for threading ThreadedGenerator's abort state into a hook closure running in a third-party worker thread (new, no current hook does this).

Base L (no exact precedent — no current hook raises or reads disconnect state; detection logic itself is proven/unit-tested but the invocation point and exception-propagation path through langgraph_supervisor/langgraph internals are not) bumped to XL by the streaming/real-time red flag: the whole bug and fix live inside LangGraph's background-executor streaming model (stream_mode=['updates','messages'], subgraphs=True), which is exactly the kind of real-time/streaming execution context the rubric flags for a risk bump. Two related in-flight tickets (EPMCDME-14855 same files, EPMCDME-15638 recursion-limit 150->1000) add sequencing/collision risk needing a rollback plan.
